entities.name: Quartermaster Amelia
entities.description: A human pirate, helmsmage and quartermaster of The Belligerent in the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan.

entities.name: Edgar
entities.description: Accompanied Vraska and Amelia to retrieve the castaway.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Castaway Vraska decided to keep aboard.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire faction whose ship the crew encountered.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Trapped by Amelia with sail canvas and made to drop the Thaumatic Compass.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: City that rose from the jungle.

events.summary: When Vraska follows the thaumatic compass south, Amelia relays the captain's orders to adjust course.
events.quote: Amelia relayed the captain's orders to the crew

events.summary: Amelia prepares the dinghy and accompanies Vraska and Edgar to retrieve a castaway, Jace Beleren.
events.quote: who turned out to be Jace Beleren

events.summary: Amelia raises the sails as the crew fights a Legion of Dusk vampire ship.
events.quote: She used her magic to raise the sails and prepare the ship for battle.

events.summary: Amelia traps Huatli with sail canvas, making her drop the compass.
events.quote: Amelia used a piece of sail canvas to trap Huatli, making her drop the Thaumatic Compass

events.summary: Orazca rises from the jungle; Vraska and Jace fall into a river, and Amelia marches into Orazca with the pirates.
events.quote: the city began to rise from the jungle, causing an earthquake and a flood

relations.quote: Amelia relayed the captain's orders to the crew

relations.quote: part of the Brazen Coalition of pirates on Ixalan
